title: Rinnai Process
sourceNote: Structured from MTC Rinnai process kit (redacted). No portal passwords, PayWay credentials, or package/unit price tables.

topics.title: Portal close-off
topics.blurb: Salesforce partner portal — arrival, asset, completion notes.

steps.text: Open the Rinnai partner portal and search by the 8-digit Rinnai Work Order number (not the SA (service appointment) number).
Pull up the matching MTC portal job sheet so you can copy details across. Photos of the data plate (and other job photos) should already be on the MTC job — Rinnai needs them for invoicing.
Arrival and JSA (job safety assessment): edit Arrival and JSA fields, set the attendance date from Prestart/job sheet, and tick JSA Completed.

Job Details: copy Make / Model / Serial from the MTC job description into the Rinnai fields. Add an Asset every job (serial, model, date of manufacture if known, Account). Incoming / operating gas pressure and CO reading can stay 0.00.
Completion: paste Description of Work from the General Job Sheet. Fix spelling/grammar, pick the correct completion reason, tick Documentation Complete, then Save.

When labour/parts and payment (if any) are done: set Payment Method, Authority No (receipt), Amount Received → Save; advance Status through to Job Completed; run Contractor Review so the Work Order closes.
Finish in MTC: forms green/complete and invoice ticked. Job is closed.

notes: Partner portal URL is the Rinnai AU Force partners login — ask the office lead for access (credentials are not stored in this Bible).
What you type in the Rinnai portal is what the customer sees — be detailed.

topics.title: Parts on the Work Order
topics.blurb: Bible finds the part → portal submits it. Warranty vs chargeable.

steps.text: Get clear part numbers from the tech (or stores). Prefer Pin 1 → Pin 2 → Pin 3 in this Bible before you submit anything on the Work Order.
On the Rinnai Work Order, open RELATED → Parts and Labour → New. Search Price Book Entry by part code (same pattern as labour codes).
Set quantity. Charge Type = Chargeable for customer-paid work, or Warranty when covered. Save.
Warranty path: ensure an Asset exists (serial, product/model, account, manufacture date, data-plate model). Then Submit Parts for Approval so Rinnai can order.

3rd-party (non-Rinnai) parts use Price Book code 3RD — enter net ex GST and contractor amount with the agreed markup. Attach supplier invoice in Files when over the process threshold. This is not Bible Net pricing.
When Rinnai ships warranty parts, stores advise arrival → rebook install. Keep portal notes current (left message / booked / payment taken).

notes: Labour desk codes (rate card): A45 call-out domestic, A15 per 15 min domestic, CFC call-out commercial, CFA per 15 min commercial.
Optional: use Focus search below to jump back to the Bible search box without leaving this desk.

actions.label: Focus Bible search
actions.hint: Closes Process and focuses the parts search box.

topics.title: Chargeable & PayWay
topics.blurb: Written quote → signed acceptance → collect via PayWay.

steps.text: At scheduling, pre-inform the customer that non-warranty work is chargeable and payable upfront on the day of service.
Provide a written itemised quote on the current Rinnai Quote Form. Do not proceed until the customer has signed acceptance.
Upload/save a copy of the signed quote to the Salesforce Work Order (or keep it where you can produce it immediately if 1stCare asks).
Add labour + parts on the Work Order first so the portal total matches what you collect. Call-out and extra time follow the MTC rate card.

Collect the full chargeable amount before job completion via Rinnai PayWay (Take Payment → required fields → Confirm). PayWay access rotates — ask admin / check email; credentials are not in this Bible.

Paste the PayWay receipt into the Rinnai Work Order Payment section and the MTC/RCTI (recipient-created tax invoice) tracking sheet. Email confirmation of payment if asked — that is not a tax invoice (Rinnai sends the tax invoice).
Refusal to pay (COD after signed quote): call 1stCare 13 43 73 option 3 while still onsite (or admin continues). Note operator name, upload signed quote, complete Work Order within 24 hours.
Customer wants an invoice before paying: not a refusal — use the Rinnai Manual Receipt after PayWay collection. Installer-will-pay claims: do not proceed; payment required first.

notes: Return visits need a fresh quote (labour ± parts) and signed acceptance; do not re-attend if the original chargeable callout is unpaid.
If payment cannot be taken, call Rinnai immediately — delays can mean Rinnai will not cover the attendance.

topics.title: Exo → Rinnai (RSW service work) + RCTI remittance
topics.blurb: Invoice Rinnai in Exo, then match the RCTI (recipient-created tax invoice) remittance.

steps.text: After portal payment details and Job Completed status: in Exo open the job Quote/Budget and create an invoice.
Use invoice code RSW (Rinnai Service Work). Charge amount comes from the Rinnai portal Payment section. Convert quote → invoice and save (no need to email the invoice off).
Set Exo status to AWAITING PAYMENT and note the close-off date in Notes.
When the RCTI (recipient-created tax invoice) remittance arrives (via Jeff), open the Rinnai RCTI tracker spreadsheet (office Admin/RSW path — outside this Bible).
New tab named for the Advice Date; copy headers. Enter Date, Voucher, Remark (Rinnai Work Order), Payment from the RCTI PDF.
Match Remark (Work Order) in Exo → Billing Schedule → paste our invoice number into the tracker. Raise any missing invoices, then return the sheet to Jeff.

notes: Always post portal notes for left-message / booked / payment taken, and mirror key notes in MTC + Exo.
Handy contacts: FSLsupport@rinnai.com.au · 1stcareinvoice@rinnai.com.au · 13 43 73 opt 3 / (03) 8581 3088 for non-payment.

topics.title: Finished goods
topics.blurb: Replace a whole unit under warranty — Zone Contractor unit list, not spare Net.

steps.text: Confirm warranty from install date / handbook. Sometimes product is covered but labour is not — quote labour to the customer separately.
Create the Asset on the Work Order first (serial + data-plate model) — same habit as warranty parts.
Look up the replacement unit on the Rinnai Zone Contractor Hot Water Price List (finished-goods workbook — not this Bible's spare Net). Like-for-like or as directed by the tech.
Add the FG item code under Parts and Labour, Charge Type = Warranty, Save. Attach supporting photos (data plate, fault, RFFG form).
Submit for Parts Approval from the Work Order overflow menu. Advise the customer when ordered; book fit when arrived; arrange site delivery with stores/purchasing if needed.

notes: Out-of-warranty domestic swap (MTC account): customer form + estimated quote → payment for callout/unit → purchasing orders → install → collect remaining labour / COC / Form 4. Exo account must be the customer, not Rinnai.

topics.title: Warranty periods
topics.blurb: Real heat exchanger / parts / labour years from Continuous Flow, Hotflo, Heat Pump sheets + Warranty info.docx. Confirm booklet before promising cover.

steps.text: Classify Domestic vs Commercial Use before reading any row. Domestic Use = typical family usage: (1) heaters supplying domestic dwellings, or (2) lodging-style commercial (motel units, hotel rooms, caravans, mobile homes, nursing homes, retirement villages / care accommodation) only when max delivery ≤70°C, not a centralised bulk HW system, and no building flow-and-return. Everything else (cafes, caravan parks, sporting complexes, industrial / commercial buildings, bulk systems, etc.) is Commercial Use.

Match the product family table below. Heat exchanger / cylinder years often differ from other components; Parts and Labour are separate columns — do not collapse them into a single “same split” figure.

Read footnotes on the matching row (extended heat exchanger options, dual controllers, solar exclusions, frost, high-temperature HD preset). Then set Work Order Charge Type = Warranty only when the claim fits the table and Asset data (serial, model, install / manufacture date) is correct.

tables.title: Gas continuous flow & instantaneous (Continuous Flow sheet)
footnote: (1) Extended Warranty Option — see Rinnai terms & conditions (not automatic).
(2) Five years on components and labour if two or more controllers are installed in domestic applications.

(3) Unsuitable for solar HW applications — failure/service in solar install is not covered, except HD models on Rinnai Demand Duo commercial solar boosting, or models converted by Rinnai specifically for Rinnai solar systems.
(5) Flowmaster 10: do not install where temperature stays below 0°C for extended periods. Frost failures are not covered.
(6) HD commercial: drops to 1 year on heat exchanger including parts and labour when pre-set to 85°C or 95°C.

Warranty info.docx also lists Hotflo 10 Instantaneous at 10 / 3 / 3 (domestic) — treat as the same instantaneous band as Flowmaster 10 unless the current booklet says otherwise. HDC follows the HD row on this Continuous Flow extract.

tables.title: Continuous flow accessories (Continuous Flow sheet)
footnote: (2) Domestic controllers: five years if two or more are installed.
(4) Accessories include pipe covers, recess boxes, security brackets, flue diverters and coaxial flueing.

tables.title: Hotflo electric storage — EHFA / EHFD (Hotflo - EFH sheet)
tables.footnote: (1) Components include sensors, thermostats, valves, electric heating elements & anodes where applicable. Warranty info.docx lists EHFS & EHFD Hotflo with the same 10-year cylinder / 1-year components pattern (domestic).

tables.title: Hotflo electric storage — HFE 80–400 L (Hotflo - HFE sheet)
tables.footnote: Sizes on the sheet: 80 L, 125 L, 160 L, 250 L, 315 L & 400 L. (1) Components = sensors, thermostats, valves, elements and anodes where applicable.

tables.title: Hotflo electric storage — HFE 25 L & 50 L (Hotflo - HFE sheet)
tables.footnote: (1) Components = sensors, thermostats, valves, elements and anodes where applicable.

tables.title: Heat pump — Enviroflo EHPA (Heat Pump sheet)
tables.footnote: (1) Components include sensors, thermostats, valves, electric heating elements, anodes, and all refrigeration components excluding the compressor.

tables.title: Other lines — Warranty info.docx desk sheet
rows: 1 year components / 3 years replacement & compressor labour
Ground VE glass 10 yr; roof VE glass 5 yr; stainless 10 yr
tables.footnote: These DOCX rows are the old office summary — prefer the Continuous Flow / Hotflo / Heat Pump PDF tables above for continuous flow, EHFA/EHFD, HFE and EHPA. Use this block for gas storage (GHF) and solar until a dedicated sheet is filed.

notes: Source kit: Continuous Flow.pdf, Heat Pump.pdf, Hotflo - EFH.pdf, Hotflo - HFE.pdf, Warranty info.docx (MTC PROCESS / Rinnai stuff). No secrets copied.

Never invent cover from memory. If the claim is borderline (solar boosting, high-temperature commercial HD, frost, extended heat exchanger option not registered), check the current Rinnai warranty booklet before approving Warranty charge-type.

checker.heading: Still unsure? - Try answering the following questions.

cf_solar.prompt: Is this on a solar hot-water install?

cf_dom_bld_hex_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Builders heat exchanger — table: parts 10 yr, labour 3 yr)

cf_dom_bld_other_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Builders other — table: 3 yr parts + labour)

cf_dom_hd_hex_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (HD domestic heat exchanger — table: parts 12 yr, labour 5 yr)

cf_dom_hd_other_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (HD domestic other parts — table: 5 yr parts + labour)

cf_dom_fm_fail.prompt: What failed? (also: frost / below-0°C installs are not covered)

cf_dom_fm_hex_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Flowmaster 10 heat exchanger — table: parts 10 yr, labour 3 yr)

cf_dom_fm_other_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Flowmaster 10 other — table: 3 yr parts + labour)

cf_comm_inf_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (commercial Infinity / Enviro / Flowmaster — table: 1 yr parts + labour)

cf_comm_hd_temp.prompt: Is the HD unit pre-set to 85°C or 95°C? (footnote drops cover to 1 year)

cf_comm_hd_hex_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (HD commercial heat exchanger — table: parts 5 yr, labour 3 yr)

cf_comm_hd_other_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (HD commercial other parts — table: 3 yr parts + labour)

acc_dom_ss_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (SmartStart domestic — table: 3 yr parts + labour)

acc_dom_ctrl_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (controllers — 3 yr; 5 yr if two or more installed)

acc_dom_other_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (other domestic accessories — table: 1 yr parts + labour)

acc_comm_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (all commercial continuous flow accessories — table: 1 year parts + labour)

hotflo_dom_cyl_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (domestic cylinder — parts 10 yr, labour 3 yr)

hotflo_dom_comp_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (domestic components — table: 1 yr parts + labour)

hotflo_small_cyl_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Hotflo HFE 25/50 L domestic cylinder — parts 7 yr, labour 3 yr)

hotflo_comm_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (commercial Hotflo — table: 1 yr parts + labour on cylinder and components)

hp_dom_cyl_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Enviroflo EHPA domestic cylinder — parts 5 yr, labour 3 yr)

hp_dom_comp_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Enviroflo EHPA domestic compressor — parts 3 yr, labour 1 yr)

hp_dom_other_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (Enviroflo EHPA other components — table: 1 year parts + labour)

hp_comm_age.prompt: Roughly how old? (commercial Enviroflo EHPA — table: 1 year parts + labour across cylinder / compressor / components)

labour_parts.title: Likely warranty — labour + parts
labour_parts.detail: Age looks inside both labour and parts years for that table row. Set Charge Type = Warranty only if Asset data (serial, model, install / manufacture date) is correct.

parts_only.title: Likely warranty — parts only
parts_only.detail: Parts years still look open; labour is outside the table band — quote labour to the customer (or confirm booklet) before promising a free visit.

chargeable.title: Likely chargeable
chargeable.detail: Age looks past the matching table years. Treat as customer-paid unless Rinnai confirms otherwise in writing.

chase_rinnai.title: Chase Rinnai / check booklet
chase_rinnai.detail: Borderline path (solar exclusion, extended heat exchanger option, dual controllers, frost, high-temperature HD, gas storage (GHF) / solar summary rows). Do not invent cover — check the current Rinnai warranty booklet or ask Rinnai before Warranty charge-type.

insufficient.title: Insufficient info
insufficient.detail: Need product family, Domestic vs Commercial Use, what failed, and a rough age (or install / manufacture date) before picking Charge Type. Use the tables above once those are known.

checker.examplesNote: Product family examples — Rinnai AU catalogue shots + Bible unit photos. Checker family chips = real warranty-table families only.

topics.title: Reading data plates
topics.blurb: Photo the plate → Pin 3 habit. Never invent chassis from memory.

steps.text: Tech photos the unit data plate on site (model, serial, manufacture date). Attach to the MTC job — Rinnai close-off needs it.
Read the plate model carefully (REU / marketing / data-plate model can differ). Use that for Asset fields and Bible Pin 3 Item Number.
In this Bible: Pin 1 type → Pin 2 series → Pin 3 full Item Number before searching parts. Series-only pins are not enough for Primary ranking.
Watch outlet temp packing: 50 = AU domestic path; 60°+ is commercial — not for domestic install.
Never guess chassis from a vague "Infinity 26" memory when ordering warranty parts or finished goods — wrong Asset = delayed approval.

notes: The kit PDF is image-only (visual plate callouts). This topic is the office habit checklist, not a scan dump.
